text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Registration of Pharmacists (Amendment

of First Schedule) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2022.

Amendment of First Schedule
text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi

(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2022.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

text.en:
2. The First Schedule to the Registration of Pharmacists Act 1951 is amended,

in relation to the country of "Malaysia", by deleting the item "University

Malaya" and the particulars relating to it.

Made 22 June 2018

[KKM.R.600-1/1/26(II); PN(PU2)200/IV]

Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad

Minister of Health

P.U. (A) 183.

AKTA KAWALAN HARGA DAN ANTIPENCATUTAN 2011

Perintah Kawalan Harga dan Antipencatutan (Penentuan Harga Runcit

Maksimum bagi Petrol dan Diesel) (No. 21) 2018

Pada menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 4 Akta Kawalan Harga

dan Antipencatutan 2011 [Akta 723], Pengawal, dengan kelulusan Menteri,

membuat perintah yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa

1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Harga dan

Antipencatutan (Penentuan Harga Runcit Maksimum bagi Petrol dan

Diesel) (No. 21) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Ogos 2018.

P.U. (A) 182-183.
1565 P.U. (A) 183.

Harga runcit maksimum bagi petrol dan diesel

2. Harga runcit maksimum bagi petrol dan diesel hendaklah sebagaimana

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan
text.ms:
2. Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 dipinda,

berhubung dengan negara "Malaysia", dengan memotong butiran "Universiti

Malaya" dan butir-butir yang berhubungan dengannya.

Dibuat 22 Jun 2018

[KKM.R.600-1/1/26(II); PN(PU2)200/IV]

 Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad

Menteri Kesihatan

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS ACT 1951

Registration of Pharmacists (Amendment of First

Schedule) Order 2018

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(3) of the Registration

of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 371], the Minister, after consulting the Board,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

text.en:
3. Perintah Kawalan Harga dan Antipencatutan (Penentuan Harga Runcit

Maksimum bagi Petrol dan Diesel) (No. 20) 2018 [P.U. (A) 170/2018] yang

disiarkan dalam Warta pada 25 Julai 2018 dibatalkan.

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING ACT 2011

Price Control and Anti-Profiteering (Determination of Maximum Retail

Price for Petrol and Diesel) (No. 21) Order 2018

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 of the Price Control and

Anti-Profiteering Act 2011 [Act 723], the Controller, with the approval of the

Minister, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Price Control and Anti-Profiteering

(Determination of Maximum Retail Price for Petrol and Diesel) (No. 21)

Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 2 August 2018.

Maximum retail price for petrol and diesel

2. The maximum retail price for petrol and diesel shall be as specified in

the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Price Control and Anti-Profiteering (Determination of Maximum

Retail Price for Petrol and Diesel) (No. 20) Order 2018 [P.U. (A) 170/2018]

published in the Gazette on 25 July 2018 is revoked.
